# ADR-3004: A01: Cross-tenant data path for tenancy boundary 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Multi-tenant platforms fail when tenant scope is optional.

## Decision

Handlers MUST NOT cross a cross-tenant data path for tenancy boundary 4 (A01-4).

## Consequences

Tenant IDs come from verified auth context only.
